profiles.title: BDGE: "This is not your grandpa's fantasy football league" (Week 6 game-by-game recap)
profiles.text: Mixes route-share and snap data with what he sees on film and plenty of profanity. He pushes back on overreactions (RJ Harvey's dud was "variance"), but he's also quick to write players off (Skattebo "take the L," Denver's WRs "useless"). He mentions his own leagues often ("your idiot league mates" league: Nico, Woody Marks, Jakobi Meyers, Fannin, Charbonnet). He was early on Kenneth Walker and takes a victory lap for it.
